Hudson Commercial Bank is listed as mortgagee on Location 1 building in the property section. Confirm the mortgagee clause is wanted on the policy.

Application and property section state all premises are owner occupied, with the liability section confirming no premises leased to others. Values and locations otherwise agree across application, property section, SOV and broker email.
Broker email lists the attachment as 'general liability section'; the file received is liability_section and the SOV is sov.csv. All listed attachments are present in the packet.

cases.title: One carrier's paid column actually holds the incurred figure

expectations.rationale: Paid plus reserved equals incurred on every row, so a row where it does not add up means a column is mislabelled and the paid figure cannot be trusted. Carriers label these columns differently.
Once a column is known to be mislabelled the incurred figure is also in doubt, so flagging it as well is defensible, though the incurred column itself still reconciles.
